{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Miami and Erie Canal was a canal in Ohio that ran about 274 mi ; it was constructed from Cincinnati to Toledo to create a water route from the Ohio River to Lake Erie.","title":"Miami and Erie Canal"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Construction on the canal began in 1825 and was completed in 1845 at a cost to the state government of $8,062,680.07.","title":"Miami and Erie Canal"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" At its peak, it included 19 aqueducts, three guard locks, 103 canal locks, multiple feeder canals, and a few man-made water reservoirs.","title":"Miami and Erie Canal"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The canal climbed 395 ft above Lake Erie and 513 ft above the Ohio River to reach a topographical peak called the Loramie Summit, which extended 19 mi between New Bremen, Ohio to lock 1-S in Lockington, north of Piqua, Ohio.","title":"Miami and Erie Canal"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" Boats up to 80 feet long were towed along the canal by mules, horses, or oxen walking on a prepared towpath along the bank, at a rate of four to five miles per hour.","title":"Miami and Erie Canal"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"The Canal de la Nieppe was part of the Hazebrouck Canals (French: \"Canaux d'Hazebrouck\" ).","title":"Canal de la Nieppe"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" It connected to the River Lys at Thiennes with a second connection to the River Lys at Merville.","title":"Canal de la Nieppe"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" It was 23 km with 4 locks.","title":"Canal de la Nieppe"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The other canals composing the Hazebrouck canals are the Canal de Préaven, Canal de la Bourre, Canal d'Hazebrouck.","title":"Canal de la Nieppe"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: noanswer","Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"noanswer","question":"Sara Baume was born near the canal on the flight of locks on which two other canals?"}
